title: Production Templates pages state tracy.ai, move direct visits there with a 301, serve the tracy.ai Worker, and demos may be framed by tracy.ai
steps: S1: Run the tracy-web HTTP seam tests: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/public-templates-page.test.mjs (production default origin, 301 vs CF-Worker pass-through, dev unaffected, /templates/sitemap.xml and /templates/llms.txt, one-hop design-inspiration redirects).
S2: Run the fleet frame policy tests: node --test packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/frame-policy.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/site-apache-conf.test.mjs.
expect: S1: every test passes, including 'the production deployment states https://tracy.ai by default' and 'a direct visit to a Templates address answers 301'.
S2: every test passes; the renderer prints frame-ancestors with https://tracy.ai beside https://*.tracy.ai, and a policy written before the apex upgrades.
evidence: Before this change production canonical/sitemap named cowork.tracy.ai, cowork served /templates/ itself, and demo sites refused to be framed by https://tracy.ai
fence: templatesPublicOrigin default, the toPublicOrigin middleware and the managed frame-ancestors renderer
